cause_quote: The new provider-policy notice used `formatUiExternalText(fallbackModel.slice(0, 256))`, which kept only the first half of an emoji when its surrogate pair straddled the cutoff.
user_saw: The Control UI's “Provider changed the model” notice showed � at the end of a fallback model label when the cutoff split an emoji.
summary: The fix truncates retry messages and provider-policy model labels at Unicode code-point boundaries within the existing 256 UTF-16 code-unit limit.
reasoning: The path history and introducing diff show that #143761 added the provider-policy notice, its provider-supplied fallback label, and the unsafe slice together. The fix PR reproduced the malformed label in Chromium, so that browser-visible failure determines the cause attribution. The same fix covers the retry-message slice introduced separately in #139397, which the fix PR exercised through a test because existing retry messages were short.
